properties.displayName: UAV S64 - Authentication Process Tamper (Auth-Stub Backdoor)
properties.description: UAVOpAudit_CL에서 auth-service 바이너리 해시가 24h 베이스라인 다수해시와 불일치하거나, 로그인 성공률이 100%로 치솟는(항상통과 백도어 의심) 이상 탐지. MITRE: T1556
properties.query:
let baselineWindow = 24h;
let alertWindow = 15m;
let successRateGate = 1.0;
let minAttempts = 10;
let BaselineHash = toscalar(
    UAVOpAudit_CL
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(baselineWindow) .. ago(alertWindow))
    | where ServiceName == "auth-service" and EventType == "login_attempt"
    | summarize HashCount = count() by BinaryHash
    | top 1 by HashCount desc
    | project BinaryHash
);
UAVOpAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where ServiceName == "auth-service" and EventType == "login_attempt"
| summarize SuccessCount = countif(Result == "success"), FailCount = countif(Result == "fail"), TotalCount = count(),
    (LastSeen, CurrentHash) = arg_max(TimeGenerated, BinaryHash) by System
| extend SuccessRate = todouble(SuccessCount) / TotalCount
| extend HashMismatch = (CurrentHash != BaselineHash)
| where TotalCount >= minAttempts and (SuccessRate >= successRateGate or HashMismatch)
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    HashMismatch and SuccessRate >= successRateGate, "인증바이너리해시불일치_전수성공_백도어의심",
    HashMismatch, "인증바이너리해시불일치_백도어의심",
    "인증프로세스_100%성공률_이상")
| extend Severity = "High"
| project LastSeen, System, SuccessCount, FailCount, TotalCount, SuccessRate, CurrentHash, BaselineHash, HashMismatch, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by LastSeen desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S64 - Authentication Process Tamper (Auth-Stub Backdoor) - {{System}}
